title: Full Body Chidori
body:
Syntax: perform full body chidori <target>

Description: A powerful Lightning Chidori that can paralyze.  Requires Lightning chakra nature. Base damage: 689-809. 25% chance to inflict paralyzed. Unlocks at level 60. Costs 56 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 5 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
